decisions.reason: The WASTX Cleanic is a publicly showcased flagship co-developed with ERMAFA and close to our core waste-treatment competencies, so after the sunk co-development costs and the visible partner commitment we persist with it and attribute slow uptake to long sales cycles in the medical-waste market.

The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant is a modular building block of the WASTX line and embodies our announced decentralized-recycling strategy, so dropping it would undercut the direction we have committed to publicly.
